## Consensus Translation

[Isaiah 50 — Israel's Sin and the Servant's Obedience — key verses from the EMET literal translation]

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 50 — "Israel's Sin and the Servant's Obedience" — part of Second Isaiah (chs.40-55). The Babylonian exile and imminent return shape the theological vision of hope and restoration.
